summary.name: Professional Summary
summary.content: Innovative and impact-driven Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer with 6+ years of experience architecting distributed microservices, responsive web applications, and enterprise LLM inference pipelines. Proven track record reducing API latency by 45%, decreasing infrastructure costs by /year, and leading cross-functional engineering teams to ship mission-critical software reaching 1M+ active users.

items.summary:
• Spearheaded migration of monolithic inference workloads to distributed Kubernetes clusters, slashing P99 latency by 42% across 2.5M daily active requests.

• Architected retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agent workflow using Gemini 1.5 Pro and pgvector, boosting answer precision from 68% to 94%.

• Mentored 8 junior and mid-level software engineers on TypeScript, React 19, and CI/CD best practices, accelerating sprint velocity by 30%.

• Built reactive real-time analytics dashboard with React, TailwindCSS, and Node.js, delivering sub-100ms charting for 500+ B2B enterprise clients.

• Designed automated Redis caching tier that decreased primary MongoDB cluster read load by 60% during peak Black Friday traffic spikes.

• Implemented end-to-end Zod and JWT validation security pipelines, eliminating OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities across 12 API microservices.

• Developed responsive single-page web applications using React, Redux, and Express.js, boosting user sign-up conversion by 28%.

• Integrated Stripe subscription billing and automated webhook reconciliation, processing .2M+ in annual transaction volume.
Focused on distributed systems, neural networks, and scalable cloud architectures. Published master thesis on low-latency transformer inference.
Graduated Magna Cum Laude. Dean's Distinguished Honors List. Vice President of Association for Computing Machinery (ACM).
